title: Chapter 749 The Aura Of Life; Self-Defeating
content:
Chapter 749 The Aura Of Life; Self-Defeating

Chapter 749 The Aura of Life; Self-Defeating

Originally, Kailin was worried about meeting Hu Tian, Huang Ling, Xia Bing, and Xia Xue.

At this moment, his heart was completely at ease.

Relaxed and happy.

This was even more heartwarming than his life in the Temple of Life.

In the following time, Lin Fan, Kailin, Hu Tian, Su Ningjing, Xia Bing, Xia Xue, and the others all lived together. The air seemed to be filled with happiness.

In the blink of an eye, five years had passed.

On this day, Huang Ling's stomach, which had not moved for a long time, suddenly bulged slightly.

This change immediately attracted everyone's attention.

Especially Kathleen, who was the most curious.

Her gorgeous eyes flickered with a faint light as she muttered,""Is this life? How strange."

In order to experience this strange feeling, she came to Lin Fan's room every day for the next month.

Tirelessly.

He worked very hard.

However, sometimes hard work didn't mean results.

No life appeared in her stomach.

....

On the other hand, the battle between the Sea Realm, the Demon Realm, and the Buddha Realm was getting more and more intense.

Planets were destroyed almost every day.

The Buddha Realm was vast and powerful.

However, the prolonged war with the Sea Realm and the Demon Realm was also unbearable for them.

On this day, the Buddha Realm was finally forced to hold a top-level meeting to discuss countermeasures.

Buddhas with golden light all over their bodies gathered together and let out a buzzing sound like a mosquito.

"The Sea Realm and the Demon Realm are vile to our Buddha Realm. What should we do?"

"Evil does not suppress good, it should be suppressed."

"The Sea Realm and the Demon Realm are too powerful."

"Now, the operation of my Buddha Realm has already been greatly affected. We have to think of a way."

"Humph! They were just a bunch of evil demons, what was there to be afraid of?"

At this moment, a Buddha that was 10,000 feet tall said,"Buddha, may I ask if there is a way to suppress Sea Saint and Demon Saint?"

As soon as he said that, the entire scene immediately fell silent.

This Buddha was Pu Guo's senior brother and had an extremely high status in the Buddha Realm. Only he could ask such a question.

Apparently, the news of Bo Han and Tyrant being cursed by the Bodhi Fruit had already spread.

The Buddhas also agreed with this.

After all, only Sacred Lords could curse Sacred Lords.

The Bodhi Fruit was a karmic saint and possessed the strongest curse power in the world.

If it wasn't him, who else could it be?

Bodhi Guo understood what the Buddhas were thinking. He sighed inwardly and said,"I never cursed Tai Ba and Bo Han."

There was a moment of silence.

The Bodhi Fruit also sank into deep thought.

If he wasn't the one who became a saint through karma, he would have doubted himself.

But if it wasn't him, then who was it?

The Bodhi Fruit inexplicably felt as if there was an invisible hand that enveloped him within. It was incomparably terrifying.

At the thought of this, a layer of cold sweat broke out on his forehead.

After a while, Bodhi Guo said," Now, let's first discuss how to deal with the Sea Realm and the Demon Realm, as well as how the outside world knows about the Holy Buddha King's sarira."

As soon as he finished speaking, he used a pair of eyes that were as dazzling as the sun to scan the scene.

The Holy Buddha King's Relic was a secret of the Buddha Realm. Only a few higher-ups knew the inside story.

Now, it was spreading like wildfire. Pu Guo obviously suspected that there was a mole in the Buddha Realm.

If there really was a mole, it was definitely someone present.

Unfortunately, the Bodhi Fruit looked at it for a long time and could not see any clues.

"The Holy Buddha King's sarira is a secret of the Buddha Realm. It indeed needs to be investigated thoroughly. "In addition, as far as I know, because of the relic, there are already several Holy Lords who have designs on our Buddha Realm. We have to be wary."

As soon as he said this, the atmosphere at the scene became somewhat solemn.

Several Saint Sovereigns. This was definitely a terrifying matter.

"I'm already aware of this matter." However, they only had this idea because the Holy Buddha King's Relic possessed all the magic power and powerful defense he had before."

"If they knew that the Holy Buddha King sarira no longer has any energy or defense, there wouldn't be any problems."

Two days later, the true effect of the Holy Buddha King's Relic was announced.

According to Pu Guo, as long as the Holy Master knew about it, there would be no problem.

However, Pu Guo did not know that this had caused some of the Holy Masters who did not believe that the Buddha Realm had the Buddha Saint King's sarira to pay even more attention to the Buddha Realm.

The Demon Realm also had the same concern as the Buddha Realm.

Since the Buddha Realm really had the mysterious Buddha Saint King's Sarira, did the Demon Realm really have the Heart of the Saint Demon King?

After consuming the Heart of the Demon Saint King, one could become a Saint King in one fell swoop.

This was obviously more tempting.

Because of the matter regarding the Heart of the Demon Sage King, the Demon Realm had no choice but to hold a high-level meeting.

Although Tai Ba was cursed, he could only forcefully suppress himself and come to the scene.

At this moment, the entire venue was clamoring.

"The Buddha Realm is too arrogant!"

"Hmph, a bunch of bald donkeys. All of you bit your heads to pieces!"

"That's right!"

....

Tai Ba was already a little crazy and frustrated because of the curse. At this moment, hearing such a commotion, he could not help but shout,"I didn't call you here to make a scene!"

"Buzz!"

A terrifying aura pressed down like a mountain. All the demons found it difficult to breathe.

The entire scene stopped abruptly.

"I'm here to ask who leaked the news of the Demon Saint King's heart!"

As soon as he finished speaking, he glanced around coldly.

Tai Ba's aura was already extremely terrifying. Coupled with this blade-like gaze, finally…A slightly weaker demon fell to the ground.

However, this made Tai Ba, who was in a state of madness, feel that the other party was guilty.

He directly stretched out his hand into a claw and tore the demon into pieces. Blood mist filled the air.

When the demons saw this, they were as silent as cicadas in winter.

"Da da!"

Tyrant's sharp claws kept jumping on the chair, making a dull sound.

After a moment, Tai Ba said," Announce that the Demon Saint King's Heart has no energy, and it's impossible for it to have the effect of breaking through to the Saint King Realm!"

His voice reverberated throughout the entire venue.

The words about Tai Ba quickly spread throughout countless universes.

Tai Ba originally wanted everyone to give up on their pursuit of the Demon Sage King's Heart.

However, he didn't expect that this would arouse the desire of all living beings.

That was because everyone only heard one sentence. The demons really had the heart of the Demon Sage King!

Perhaps, after eating it, he could become an invincible Saint King!

Even if he couldn't become a Saint King, becoming a Saint Lord wouldn't be a problem.

....

Therefore, after the Buddhist Realm and the Demon Realm announced their plans, more and more living beings joined the battle. Even some Sacred Lords who were originally ignorant of the world began to take action.

Countless undercurrents surged in the universe. Gradually, the entire world seemed to fall into unprecedented chaos.

Slaughter and bloodshed erupted.
